title: Go / went / gone
descriptionFa: go با وسیله و حرف اضافه، برنامه‌ی آینده با going to، و فعالیت‌های go + ing.

words.example: We went to Shiraz last spring.
words.tipFa: سه شکل: go / went / gone. She has gone home.

words.example: I usually go by bus, but today I'm walking.
words.tipFa: by + وسیله بدون the: by car, by train, by bike.

words.example: Don't go into my room without asking!
Please go out of the room quietly.
words.tipFa: go out (بدون of) یعنی «بیرون رفتن برای تفریح»: We go out on Fridays.

words.example: The lift is broken, so we have to go up the stairs.
Go down this street and turn left at the bank.
I'm going to learn Spanish next year.
words.tipFa: be going to + فعل ساده: She's going to study maths.

words.example: Let's go shopping at the bazaar on Friday.
words.tipFa: go shopping، نه go to shopping یا go for shopping.

words.example: On Saturday nights, they like to go dancing.
We want to go sightseeing in Isfahan.
My grandfather and I go fishing on the Caspian.
It's late. I want to go home.
words.tipFa: بدون to: go home، نه go to home یا go at home.

words.example: I love Kish. I go there every summer.
words.tipFa: بدون to: go there، نه go to there. همین‌طور go somewhere / anywhere.

words.example: Go away! I'm trying to sleep.
words.tipFa: برای سفر هم هست: We're going away for the weekend.
